summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a Second Supplemental Indenture to its base indenture, appointing Computershare Advantage Trust of Canada as Canadian Trustee for new series of notes (2031 and 2036) and establishing associated terms. This is a routine debt issuance and trustee appointment, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing supplements existing indentures for note issuance without any equity, M&A, or corporate-control implications.
